title: An imported plan with its price in the name becomes a plan hundreds of months long
what: When another software's sheet names a plan with its price before the length word, such as '999 Monthly', 'Rs 1500 monthly' or '1200 Yearly', the import reads the last three digits of the price as the plan's length: 999 months, 500 months, or 200 years. A row with a start date but no end date then gets a membership that runs for decades, so the member never shows as due for renewal, and the new plan of that name is saved with that length for future sales.
expected: A number that is a price (four or more digits, or written after Rs or the rupee sign) is never read as a length; only a number right before a length word counts, and the row's own dates decide when they are given.
how_often: every import whose plan names carry a price and whose rows lack an end date
fix_line: Only read a length from a number that stands alone before a month, year, week or day word

title: A member who brings two friends with the same name gets free days only once, though both show as thanked
what: The check that stops a second thank-you after a lost save looks only for the friend's name in the member's plan notes. If the same member brings a second friend with the same name (two people called Rahul, say), the owner taps to thank them, no free days are added, and the enquiry is still marked as thanked with the days, so nobody notices the member was short-changed.
expected: A repeat thank-you is recognised by the enquiry itself, not by the friend's name, so each friend who joins earns the member their free days once.
how_often: whenever one member brings two friends with the same name
fix_line: Mark the thank-you with the enquiry it came from and check that instead of the name

title: The Monday WhatsApp summary counts new members and plans ending by different rules from Today
what: Today's 'New members' leaves out members who were archived since, and its renewals leave out pass members (FITPASS, cultpass). The Monday summary the owner sends on WhatsApp counts archived new members and counts pass members whose old plan ends this week. For the same week the owner can see two different numbers.
expected: The Monday summary uses the same rules as Today's numbers, so a number means the same thing wherever the owner reads it.
how_often: weeks with an archived new member or a pass member's plan ending
fix_line: Build the Monday summary's counts from the same lists Today uses
